output.reason: On its own the PR states the change clearly. The application controller started its app informer before shard initialization, so all applications were first assigned to shard 0 (application-controller-0). Once shard allocations were built, that controller gave a warning and stopped syncing any application. The fix moves shard initialization before the app informer starts in controller/appcontroller.go [ev-e8aa9d340122][ev-491b23d3fbe4][ev-4f42a7623279]. However, the same 3.0.0 Bug fixes section also lists a revert of this exact fix, PR #22354 [ev-d35ac549b565], next to the fix itself [ev-8102a79a3745]. Nothing shown says whether the fix was re-applied or what the revert was for, so we can't tell whether 3.0.0 ships any net change. That needs the revert PR and the final state of the code before subject, applicability and consequence can be asserted.
